ud8.4:2.1: VIII. = VIII.1.2.. etam atthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velānaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi:
ud8.4:3.1: nissitassa ca calitaṃ, anissitassa calitaṃ n' atthi, calite asati passaddhi, passaddhiyā sati rati na hoti, ratiyā asati āgatigati na hoti, āgatigatiyā asati cutūpapāto na hoti, cutūpapāte asati n' ev' idha na huraṃ na ubhayamantare, es' ev' anto dukkhassā 'ti. ||4||
